name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.231: The database refresh now refreshes the query statistics as well, and SubDL can see
    who is calling. The refresh ran VACUUM alone — that shrinks the file but leaves the query
    planner guessing which index to use. It now runs ANALYZE in the same pass, which costs one
    database page; measured on this schema, the plan for one of the plugin's own lookups moved off
    the worse index and onto the selective one. Separately, every API call now names the
    integration (client=other) and carries the real plugin version in its User-Agent, which until
    now reported "1.0" for every release.
